Name: Poke Ball Weapons and Objects
Author: Lucidvisionsinc
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Poké Ball Weapons and Objects[/b][/size]
[size=4]Standalone, non-craftable throwable Poké Ball weapons for Stardew Valley 1.6[/size][/center]

Poké Ball Weapons adds 13 throwable Poké Ball weapons with distinct combat stats, bouncing explosive projectiles, custom sounds, and configurable weapon sprites. Buy most balls from shops around the valley, find the limited-stock GS Ball at the Traveling Cart, and unlock the Master Ball through the Adventurer's Guild.

This is the standalone, non-craftable weapons pack. For Apricorn trees, machines, and craftable Poké Balls, see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53889]Poké Ball Collection[/url]. Collection is a separate mod with its own weapons and crafting progression.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]13 weapon variants: Poké Ball, Great Ball, Ultra Ball, Premier Ball, Master Ball, Infinity Master Ball, Heal Ball, Heavy Ball, Net Ball, Level Ball, Dive Ball, Lure Ball, and GS Ball.[/*]
[*]Each weapon has its own damage range, knockback, precision, critical-hit stats, area of effect, and projectile behavior.[/*]
[*]Thrown projectiles have individual damage, velocity, bounce counts, and sprite frames; all are configured as explosive projectiles.[/*]
[*]Custom Poké Ball sounds for throwing, bouncing, and impact.[/*]
[*]Configurable weapon artwork, including modern, alternate, and large sprite options; small sprites are available for selected weapons.[/*]
[*]Optional projectile sprite patches and an optional vanilla Galaxy Sword replacement.[/*]
[*]Most weapons are purchased from several shops. The Master Ball has a guild-mail unlock, and the GS Ball is a rare Traveling Cart item.[/*]
[/list]

[b]How to read the stats[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Damage[/b] is the weapon's configured minimum-to-maximum damage range.[/*]
[*][b]Knockback[/b] is the weapon's knockback value; larger values push enemies farther.[/*]
[*][b]Precision[/b] uses Stardew Valley's 0–10 weapon scale. Higher values mean greater precision.[/*]
[*][b]Crit chance[/b] is the configured probability of a critical hit. For example, 3% is a 0.03 value in the data.[/*]
[*][b]Crit multiplier[/b] is the configured critical-hit damage multiplier.[/*]
[*][b]Projectile damage[/b] is the projectile's separate configured damage value. [b]Area of effect[/b], [b]velocity[/b], and [b]bounces[/b] are the projectile and weapon values in the pack data.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Where to get them[/b]

Poké Ball, Great Ball, Net Ball, Level Ball, Premier Ball, Ultra Ball, Heal Ball, Heavy Ball, Lure Ball, and Dive Ball are stocked by Pierre, Marlon, the Dwarf, Krobus, Robin, Sandy, and the Desert Trader. Prices range from 400g to 1,000g depending on the ball.

The Master Ball costs 18,000g and is stocked by Marlon, the Desert Trader, Sandy, the Dwarf, and Krobus after you receive the Adventurer's Guild membership mail. The Dwarf and Krobus also require 750 friendship points.

The GS Ball costs 5,000g and appears as one unit of stock at the Traveling Cart. No shop stock or direct acquisition event is configured for the Infinity Master Ball entry in this pack. The optional Galaxy Sword replacement setting changes vanilla weapon entries and artwork to Master Ball and Infinity Master Ball versions.

[b]Content Patcher config options[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Pokeballpatches[/b] (default: true): enables the pack's projectile sheet patches, including the GS Ball frame.[/*]
[*][b]Replace_GalaxySword[/b] (default: off): replaces the Galaxy Sword and its matching upgraded weapon data/art with Poké Ball-themed versions.[/*]
[*][b]V2Weapons[/b] (default: false): enables alternate weapon sprites.[/*]
[*][b]bigspritesWeapons[/b] (default: false): enables large weapon sprites.[/*]
[*][b]smallweapons[/b] (default: false): enables small sprites for selected weapon/replacement entries.[/*]
[*][b]modernweapons[/b] (default: true): enables modern weapon sprites.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]

Poké Ball Weapons can be installed alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53889]Poké Ball Collection[/url]. They are separate mods with separate item IDs. Do not install this Content Patcher weapons pack alongside the old AMF weapons version; choose one weapons version.

[b]About this version[/b]

Version 2.0.1 fixes the Content Patcher JSON so the pack loads. The roster includes the GS Ball, and all 13 weapon Precision values use Stardew Valley's 0–10 scale.

[size=3]This Content Patcher pack does not include the legacy AMF-only effects described in older versions, such as Heal Ball recovery after defeating an enemy or level-scaling Heavy Ball critical chance.[/size]
